title: Protest on the Journalists’ Syndicate steps over Israeli vessel passage and reported cargo docking
exclusion_reason: The source describes an executed public protest and domestic-government calls, but reports only “a couple of dozen” participants, below the codebook’s 50-person minimum. It is excluded on published threshold evidence; no broader claim about other November gatherings follows.

start_date.summary: Mada Masr dates the protest to November 3, 2024.

location.summary: Steps of the Journalists’ Syndicate in Cairo.

participants_original.summary: Mada Masr reports a couple of dozen protesters.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: A couple of dozen is below 50; no contrary estimate reported.

demands.summary: Protesters condemned transit/docking and called on Egyptian authorities for action and for release of people detained in solidarity actions.
